risks.risk: High shutter count (actuations) indicating the camera is near the end of its mechanical life.
risks.proof: A screenshot of the shutter count from a tool like 'myshuttercount' using the last photo taken.
risks.if_unproven: as having a very high shutter count near mechanical failure.

risks.risk: Sensor damage, scratches, or excessive dust that affects image quality.
risks.proof: A clear, close-up photo of the sensor with the mirror locked up or a photo of a white wall at f/22.
risks.if_unproven: as having a damaged sensor requiring professional repair.

risks.risk: Rear LCD screen may be cracked, scratched, or have dead pixels.
risks.proof: A photo of the back of the camera with the screen turned on.
risks.if_unproven: as having a non-functional or heavily damaged display.

risks.risk: Missing or third-party batteries and charger.
risks.proof: A photo showing the two batteries and the charger together.
